title: Alyah ⭐️: Toward Robust Evaluation of Emirati Dialect Capabilities in Arabic LLMs
tldr: This blog post introduces "Alyah", a new benchmark designed to robustly evaluate the capabilities of Arabic Large Language Models in understanding and generating Emirati dialect. It addresses the critical need for fine-grained linguistic evaluation beyond standard Arabic, highlighting specific challenges and advancements in dialectal NLP.

title: Unlocking Agentic RL Training for GPT-OSS: A Practical Retrospective
tldr: This article provides a practical retrospective on implementing and optimizing agentic Reinforcement Learning training specifically for GPT-OSS (Open-Source Software) models. It delves into the technical challenges and effective strategies for integrating RL with large language models to enable more autonomous and goal-driven behaviors.

title: Adaptive Inference in NVIDIA TensorRT for RTX Enables Automatic Optimization
tldr: NVIDIA's TensorRT for RTX now features adaptive inference, automatically optimizing execution strategies based on real-time workload characteristics to maximize performance on RTX GPUs. This enhancement dynamically adjusts model partitioning and kernel selection, leading to improved throughput and reduced latency for AI applications.

title: Build a serverless AI Gateway architecture with AWS AppSync Events
tldr: This AWS ML blog post outlines how to construct a serverless AI Gateway architecture utilizing AWS AppSync Events, providing a scalable and efficient method for managing AI service interactions. It details the integration of various AWS services to create a robust and secure endpoint for AI model access and event-driven data flows.

title: **NVIDIA Earth-2 Open Models Span the Whole Weather Stack**
tldr: NVIDIA has released open-source models under the Earth-2 initiative, providing a comprehensive suite of AI models for weather and climate simulation spanning the entire 'weather stack'. This release aims to accelerate research and development in climate science by democratizing access to powerful, high-resolution predictive capabilities.

title: How to Unlock Local Detail in Coarse Climate Projections with NVIDIA Earth-2
tldr: This NVIDIA developer blog details the technical methodology for downscaling coarse climate projections to reveal local-level detail, leveraging the advanced capabilities of NVIDIA Earth-2. It describes the computational techniques and model architectures employed to generate high-resolution climate insights from lower-resolution input data.

title: Build AI agents with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore using AWS CloudFormation
tldr: This blog details a technical guide for deploying AI agents built with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore by leveraging AWS CloudFormation for infrastructure as code. It provides insights into automating the setup and management of agent environments, ensuring consistent and reproducible deployments for AI agent development.

title: Unrolling the Codex agent loop
tldr: This engineering blog post details the internal workings of OpenAI's Codex agent loop, explaining how it iteratively refines code and task execution through a process of 'unrolling'. It elucidates the technical architecture and feedback mechanisms that enable the agent to address complex programming challenges and achieve sophisticated autonomous behavior.

title: Scaling NVFP4 Inference for FLUX.2 on NVIDIA Blackwell Data Center GPUs
tldr: This NVIDIA developer blog provides an in-depth technical analysis on scaling NVFP4 inference for the FLUX.2 model specifically on NVIDIA Blackwell Data Center GPUs. It delves into the architectural considerations, optimization techniques, and performance benchmarks achieved by utilizing the new low-precision format on cutting-edge hardware for large-scale AI deployment.

title: Scaling PostgreSQL to power 800 million ChatGPT users
tldr: This technical article from OpenAI's engineering team outlines the advanced strategies and infrastructure optimizations implemented to scale PostgreSQL, efficiently supporting 800 million ChatGPT users globally. It explores architectural decisions like sharding, connection pooling, and custom caching layers crucial for maintaining high performance and availability under extreme load.

Claude's new constitution
tldr: Anthropic has announced an updated "constitution" for its Claude family of AI models, refining the core principles that govern their behavior, safety, and alignment. This technical evolution aims to further enhance the models' ability to self-supervise and adhere to ethical guidelines, thereby strengthening defenses against misuse and improving trustworthy deployment.

title: Streamlining CUB with a Single-Call API
tldr: NVIDIA has released a new single-call API for CUB (CUDA Unbound Utilities), their GPU-accelerated parallel primitive library. This update drastically simplifies the integration and usage of CUB's high-performance algorithms, such as sorting, scanning, and reduction, by reducing boilerplate code and improving developer productivity for CUDA-based applications.

title: Build agents to learn from experiences using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore episodic memory
tldr: This AWS ML blog provides a technical guide on constructing AI agents that can learn from past interactions by integrating Amazon Bedrock AgentCore's episodic memory capabilities. It details the mechanisms for agents to store and retrieve contextual experiences, enhancing their ability to adapt and make informed decisions over time.

title: Using Strands Agents to create a multi-agent solution with Meta’s Llama 4 and Amazon Bedrock
tldr: This blog post explores the technical implementation of a multi-agent solution by combining Strands Agents with Meta’s Llama 4 and Amazon Bedrock. It details the architectural patterns and integration strategies required to orchestrate multiple AI agents and large language models for complex problem-solving.

title: Deploy agents instantly with Agent Builder templates
tldr: LangChain has introduced an Agent Builder template library, allowing developers to rapidly deploy and customize AI agents with pre-configured architectures and tools. This release streamlines the development process for agentic applications, enabling faster experimentation and deployment of complex AI workflows.

title: Building Multi-Agent Applications with Deep Agents
tldr: This LangChain blog post details the process of building sophisticated multi-agent applications using "Deep Agents," providing a framework for designing and orchestrating autonomous AI entities. It covers architectural considerations and practical implementation strategies for complex, collaborative agent systems.

title: AssetOpsBench: Bridging the Gap Between AI Agent Benchmarks and Industrial Reality
tldr: IBM Research introduces AssetOpsBench, a new benchmark designed to assess AI agent performance in scenarios that closely reflect industrial operational realities. This benchmark aims to provide more relevant and rigorous evaluation metrics, addressing limitations of existing benchmarks in real-world applicability for asset management and maintenance.

title: Introducing multimodal retrieval for Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases
tldr: Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases now support multimodal retrieval, enabling users to query and retrieve information from diverse data types including text, images, and potentially other modalities. This enhancement significantly improves the grounding capabilities of LLMs by allowing them to access and synthesize a richer context from knowledge bases.

title: From Traces to Insights: Understanding Agent Behavior at Scale
tldr: This article addresses the technical challenge of understanding and debugging complex AI agent behaviors at scale by leveraging tracing and analytical tools to convert raw execution traces into actionable insights. It provides methodologies for monitoring, diagnosing, and optimizing agent performance and interactions in intricate systems.

title: Multimodal reinforcement learning with agentic verifier for AI agents
tldr: This research introduces a novel framework for training AI agents using multimodal reinforcement learning, incorporating an agentic verifier to enhance learning reliability. The verifier component provides crucial feedback, enabling agents to interpret and act upon complex sensory inputs more effectively across diverse environments.
